# Q3 Sales Report — James Okafor: Key Won Deals

**Report Period:** Q3 2026 (July – September)
**Sales Representative:** James Okafor

---

## Overview

This report highlights three notable won deals closed by James Okafor during Q3 2026. These deals span three different regions and represent a combined revenue of **$250,500**.

---

## Deal Summary

| Deal ID | Region | Product               | Amount    | Close Date |
|---------|--------|-----------------------|-----------|------------|
| D001    | North  | Meridian Insights Pro | $87,500   | 2026-07-05 |
| D003    | East   | Meridian DataBridge   | $43,000   | 2026-07-12 |
| D006    | South  | Meridian Insights Pro | $120,000  | 2026-07-22 |

---

## Key Metrics

- **Total Revenue:** $250,500
- **Average Deal Size:** $83,500
- **Largest Deal:** D006 — $120,000 (Meridian Insights Pro, South)
- **Smallest Deal:** D003 — $43,000 (Meridian DataBridge, East)

---

## Product Breakdown

| Product               | Deals | Total Revenue |
|-----------------------|-------|---------------|
| Meridian Insights Pro | 2     | $207,500      |
| Meridian DataBridge   | 1     | $43,000       |

---

## Regional Breakdown

| Region | Deals | Total Revenue |
|--------|-------|---------------|
| North  | 1     | $87,500       |
| East   | 1     | $43,000       |
| South  | 1     | $120,000      |

---

## Highlights

- All three deals were closed in **July 2026**, demonstrating a strong start to the quarter.
- **Meridian Insights Pro** accounted for the majority of revenue (83% of total).
- James achieved geographic diversity, closing deals across the **North**, **East**, and **South** regions.

---

*Source: data/sales_q3.csv*
